content.overview: Section 378A defines key terms for Chapter XXIA (Producer Companies), including active Member, Chief Executive, Member, patronage, patronage bonus, primary produce, producer, Producer Company and Producer Institution.
content.glance: Definition clause for the Producer Company Part (Chapter XXIA).
content.study: Section 378A supplies the definitions used throughout Chapter XXIA. A Producer Company is a body corporate having objects specified in section 378B and registered as a Producer Company. Primary produce covers produce of farmers from agriculture, animal husbandry, horticulture, floriculture, pisciculture, viticulture, forestry, forest products, re-vegetation, bee raising and farming plantation products, and the produce of persons engaged in handloom, handicraft and other cottage industries. A producer is a person engaged in any activity connected with or relatable to primary produce. These definitions control membership, objects, benefits and governance under the Part.

sections.heading: Rule
sections.body: Key terms for the Producer Company regime (active Member, patronage, primary produce, producer, Producer Company, Producer Institution, etc.) are defined in section 378A.

examples.title: Illustration — s. 378A
examples.body: Application of the Producer Company definitions to determine whether a person or institution falls within the Chapter XXIA framework.

hypotheticals.question: What is the core effect of s. 378A?
hypotheticals.analysis: It defines the terms that govern who may form, join and benefit from a Producer Company under Chapter XXIA.

misconceptions.trap: Treating s. 378A as optional or non-statutory.
misconceptions.correction: Section 378A is a binding definitional provision for the entire Producer Company Part.

questionsAndAnswers.question: How should s. 378A be analysed?
questionsAndAnswers.answer: I. State the defined terms. II. Apply them to the facts. III. Conclude on Chapter XXIA applicability.
